revision_note: v2 (this file, derived from v1 = reference.json, which is NOT modified): four zoom-inspection corrections applied, all re-derived directly from porterville-floor.json linework (no candidate export read or copied). (1) BATH: a framed poche chase in the NE corner (linen/plumbing chase) is now excluded from the ring per rule 5 -- previously the ring ran straight across the north wall into the east wall, silently including the chase's void as if it were open Bath floor. (2) PANTRY/LIVING: the west opening is bounded by two poche wall stubs (not a single line as v1 assumed) -- both rings now notch to the stub-pair's centerline across the actual opening span between the stub ends, per rule 3. (3) LIVING: the front entry door in the south exterior wall (opening x=1235.3-1343.0) now gets its rule-3 centerline notch -- v1 ran the south edge straight through it. (4) OPT. BEDROOM / LIVING partition door: the notch's north (top) jamb is moved from y=2300.2 (utility-row bottom) down to y=2315.5 (south face of the fixed jamb/header block above the door), on BOTH rings, so the fixed block is no longer incorrectly included inside the notched opening. CL. and W/D rings are unchanged from v1 and are repeated here verbatim for completeness.
